classifiedFinding.title: Owner can zero out emissions mid-stake via setTargetAPY(0) or setDispatcherHook(address(0)), unilaterally halting reward accrual without triggering Pausable

classification.assetImpact: No theft; principal recoverable; rewards already settled into committedDebt are still claimable. Stakers committed NFTs based on a published targetAPY and runway; the owner can collapse that commitment to zero with no notice or timelock. Pure centralization risk.
attackPath: 1. Users commit NFTs based on a visible targetAPY (e.g., 30%) with a multi-year runway.
2. Owner calls setTargetAPY(0) (a documented 'pause emissions via APY' mode per CLAUDE.md item 7), or setDispatcherHook(address(0)).
3. Future emissions collapse to zero; runway evaporates with no on-chain notice or veto.
4. Users unstake and receive only accrual up to the setter timestamp; advertised future APY is lost.
classification.likelihood: n/a - centralization risk; predicate is owner action only.
classification.assumptions: Owner key is honest and trusted; per C4 universal-invalid policy, key compromise is out of scope.

classifiedFinding.justification: Centralization. Documented spec behaviour (CLAUDE.md item 7: 'A == 0 is a supported pause emissions via APY mode'). No external-attacker path; not a deviation from spec but a surfaced privilege concern. Per C4 conventions, centralization risks belong in the QA/centralization bundle. The recommendation (timelock, monotonicity, or explicit user-facing docs) is governance maturity rather than a code bug.
